subject: Consolidated co-sell evidence & metering verification plan (Azure + GCP)
messages:
From: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
To: Maria Torres <maria@nebula-analytics.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 22 Oct 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Consolidated co-sell evidence & metering verification plan (Azure + GCP)

Hi Maria —

Thanks again for the call yesterday. As we discussed, to move Nebula's co-sell listing forward on GCP and Azure we need a consolidated evidence package and a short metering verification plan so the marketplace teams can validate entitlement and usage routing. To keep things manageable for both clouds, can you provide the following by end of day Monday (2026-10-26)?

- SKU map (SKU IDs, friendly names, metering tags, and which cloud SKU they map to) — spreadsheet preferred.
- Architecture diagram showing marketplace billing hook + customer onboarding flow (PDF).
- A short CSV of recent metering pings or synthetic test results (timestamp, SKU tag, customer-id placeholder).
- Confirmation of whether Nebula will use Azure Marketplace metering or an external meter (and the service principal/email used).

Ben / Soojin, can you confirm if we also need a DocuSign for the co-sell entitlement form or if the HubSpot deal record will suffice for initial co-sell enablement?

I created a Drive folder for artifacts and a lightweight verification doc (link below) — feel free to drop files there. Once we have the artifacts I'll coordinate a short joint validation session with the GCP Marketplace Ops team.

Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1A2b3Cexample
HubSpot deal: hubspot:deals/5482

Thanks — appreciate the quick turnaround on this.

— Lauren
Lauren Bishop
Head of Partner Ops, Redwood Inference
lauren.bishop@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0143

Attachments: (placeholder) co-sell-checklist-template.docx

From: Maria Torres <maria@nebula-analytics.com>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 23 Oct 2026 11:05:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Consolidated co-sell evidence & metering verification plan (Azure + GCP)

Thanks Lauren —

Quick update from Nebula: we can deliver the SKU map and infra diagram by Monday. Attaching an initial SKU spreadsheet and a first-pass infra diagram for visibility. A few clarifying items below:

1) Metering approach: we currently push usage events to our billing pipeline; for Azure we'd prefer using Azure Marketplace metering (publisher-managed) but can support a proxy that emits the marketplace-specific meter tags if needed.
2) For GCP we need to confirm whether the marketplace expects direct metering or partner-linked entitlements (we've seen both).
3) Test account: we can provision a sandbox tenant for Redwood to run a short metering smoke test.

I'll attach: nebula_sku_map.xlsx, infra_diagram.pdf. Metering CSV will follow after we sanitize customer ids.

Would you like us to open a ticket with GCP Marketplace Ops to pre-route any questions?

Best,
Maria Torres
Head of Cloud Partnerships, Nebula Analytics
maria@nebula-analytics.com
Attachments: nebula_sku_map.xlsx (spreadsheet), infra_diagram.pdf (diagram)

From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Maria Torres <maria@nebula-analytics.com>, GCP Marketplace Ops <gcp-marketplace-ops@google.com>
Date: Mon, 26 Oct 2026 08:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Consolidated co-sell evidence & metering verification plan (Azure + GCP)

Thanks Maria — attaching a short checklist I put together for the validation call (link to doc below). A couple of internal asks before the session:

- Ben: can your team run a quick mapping of Nebula SKU tags to Redwood routing rules so we can confirm entitlement match?
- Maria: please drop the sanitized metering_test_results.csv in the Drive folder and share the sandbox tenant credentials (temp account).
- Lauren: propose we schedule the joint validation window Thursday 10/29 10:00–11:00 PT; if that works I will invite the GCP ops engineer and our product/tech lead.

Validation doc: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1XyZ-cosell-playbook
Drive folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1A2b3Cexample

If anyone needs to re-prioritize dates, call it out — otherwise I'll lock the Thursday slot.

— Soojin
Soojin Lee
Sr. Partner Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
soojin_lee@redwood.com
Attachments: cosell-validation-checklist.pdf (stub)

From: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
To: Maria Torres <maria@nebula-analytics.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, GCP Marketplace Ops <gcp-marketplace-ops@google.com>
Date: Wed, 28 Oct 2026 15:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Consolidated co-sell evidence & metering verification plan (Azure + GCP)

All —

Thanks for the quick work. We now have the SKU map and infra diagram in the shared Drive and Maria confirmed the sandbox. Ben confirmed he'll run the SKU-to-routing map and drop his notes in the Drive by Wednesday EOD.

Next steps:
- Ben to deliver SKU routing mapping (ETA: 2026-10-28 EOD) — Ben will also flag any SKU name collisions with our routing rules.
- Maria to drop sanitized metering_test_results.csv and sandbox creds (ETA: 2026-10-28 EOD).
- Soojin to run the joint validation call with GCP ops on Thu 2026-10-29 10:00–11:00 PT (calendar invite sent).
- Lauren to open HubSpot task and attach artifacts; will set the co-sell enablement milestone (HB-5482).

If validation goes well we'll push the evidence bundle to both marketplace portals and request entitlement activation. I'll also prepare a short exec summary for partner leadership.

Thanks everyone — talk on Thursday.

— Lauren
Lauren Bishop
Head of Partner Ops, Redwood Inference
lauren.bishop@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0143
